newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF GRAF V SPIRLEA.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS SPOTLIGHT-ANALYSIS OF GRAF V SPIRLEA.

text.p: Analysis of Sunday's French Open women's singles fourth round match between second seed Steffi Graf of Germany and 13th seed Irina Spirlea of Romania, won 6-7 (4-7) 6-2 6-2 by Graf.

A double-fault by Graf allowed Spirlea to break her in the opening game. Both players then held serve until the eighth game, in which Spirlea lost hers by hitting a backhand long. Graf went on to win her serve to love and lead 5-4. In the next game, an unforced error by Spirlea gave Graf a set point but the Romanian saved it with a winning volley. A tie-break was needed. Spirlea won it 7-4, firing an ace on set point.

Spirlea double-faulted on break point in the first game and again in the fifth to go 4-1 down. In the next game, she wasted five break points before making an unforced error to allow Graf to win her serve. Spirlea won the next game to love before the German served for the set.

Graf broke Spirlea in the first game and in the fifth, opening up a 4-1 lead. Spirlea kept fighting, taking her opponent's serve in the following game with a winning return on break point. But Graf broke the Romanian again to go 5-2 up and served for the match. Spirlea hit a backhand return into the net on match point.
